provenance.source_validation: Private source audit reported; public checker validates only this published projection

claims.title: Geometry and detector belong to different chords
claims.excluded_conclusion: Combining a 12114.627 km ideal flight time with a 10800 km receiver as one calibrated channel
claims.required_bridge: A single documented geometry and a validated end-to-end detector model

claims.title: Exact and rounded conditional error inputs differ
claims.excluded_conclusion: Transferring results between 34/3336 and 0.010192 without an explicit comparison
claims.required_bridge: Exact parameter conversion and a justified joint noise law

claims.title: Repetition100 does not certify the RS payload code
claims.excluded_conclusion: Transferring a repetition100 PER bound to the 256-bit RS/repetition/CRC implementation
claims.required_bridge: A finite-code bound for that actual decoder and its channel assumptions

claims.title: Single-server replay is not a multiprocess decoder pool
claims.excluded_conclusion: Dividing a measured decoder median by worker count to guarantee per-packet latency
claims.required_bridge: Implementation-specific service, scheduling, buffer and arrival bounds

claims.title: Ideal propagation is not delivery latency
claims.excluded_conclusion: Claiming every packet beats fiber, or assigning zero latency to a dropped packet
claims.required_bridge: Delivery-aware latency accounting including service, waiting and failures

claims.title: p-B11 and CD2 use different energy boundaries
claims.excluded_conclusion: Treating a gross source-energy estimate as facility or network power
claims.required_bridge: Matched source, conversion and complete facility-energy accounting

claims.title: Source energy does not calibrate a timestamp
claims.excluded_conclusion: Inferring registration precision from 60 fs irradiation or emitted kinetic energy
claims.required_bridge: Measured moderation, conversion, transport and detector timing response

claims.title: A static density ensemble is not temporal jitter
claims.excluded_conclusion: Attributing observed packet erasures to changing mantle density without a dynamics model
claims.required_bridge: Calibrated phase-to-time response and justified temporal covariance

claims.title: Ideal qubits do not establish neutrino encoding
claims.excluded_conclusion: Treating a two-dimensional BB84 model as realized neutrino state preparation and measurement
claims.required_bridge: Experimental preparation, transmission, measurement and side-channel characterization

claims.title: Intercept-resend disturbance is not general secrecy
claims.excluded_conclusion: Inferring universal attack detection or certified secret-key rate from f/4
claims.required_bridge: A specified authenticated protocol and an applicable composable security proof

claims.title: Candidate strings are not certified secret keys
claims.excluded_conclusion: Calling the 3937 postprocessed candidates secret bits or replacing unknown SKR with zero
claims.required_bridge: Security accounting for actual leakage, authentication and privacy amplification

claims.title: Global phase alone does not change the fixed-DOS rate
claims.excluded_conclusion: Claiming all observables or the intrinsic beta-decay width change because of a global phase
claims.required_bridge: A physical mechanism beyond amplitude-norm invariance and fixed final-state density

claims.title: A supplied DOS correction is not a QFT derivation
claims.excluded_conclusion: Using center-of-mass ring density or a phenomenological correction as beta-decay QFT
claims.required_bridge: A weak-interaction final-state derivation with correct parameter domain

claims.title: Unidentified loss channels do not identify beta lifetime
claims.excluded_conclusion: Equating total-storage disappearance with intrinsic beta lifetime
claims.required_bridge: Independent loss calibration, exposure/censoring model and an identifiability argument
